title: Hotbit closes TIME T+1 DeFi Farm investment product
notes: First-party notice states subscription closed on 2 February, remaining positions would be automatically redeemed on 3 February, and users could check their investment accounts on 4 February. It does not establish external withdrawal completion.

title: Hotbit closes multiple T+1 DeFi Farm investment products
notes: First-party notice lists IOTX, REEF, WOO, BOTTO, OOE, EOS and ALICE T+1 DeFi Farm products, closes subscriptions, schedules automatic redemption, and says balances can then be checked in the investment account.

title: Hotbit closes SPS staking investment product
notes: First-party notice documents closure and automatic redemption. The article title calls the product T+8 while the body calls it T+28, so CYA does not resolve the inconsistent term label by guesswork.

title: Crypto Trading Platform Hotbit Terminates CEX Operations
notes: Contemporaneous report states Hotbit terminated centralized-exchange operations and users had until 04:00 UTC on 21 June to withdraw assets. The deadline does not prove withdrawal completion.

title: Hotbit Shutters Crypto Exchange, Urges Users to Withdraw Funds
notes: Independent contemporaneous report quotes Hotbit's shutdown statement: CEX operations would stop from 04:00 UTC on 22 May and users were asked to withdraw remaining assets by 04:00 UTC on 21 June.
